probe: SELECT ticker, shares, avg_cost FROM holdings WHERE user_email = :email AND upper(ticker) = 'GME'

extra_probes.sql: SELECT market_ticker, title, side, shares, status FROM positions WHERE user_email = :email AND (lower(title) LIKE '%gamestop%' OR lower(title) LIKE '%gme%' OR lower(market_ticker) LIKE '%gme%' OR lower(market_ticker) LIKE '%gamestop%')
